column1: # Every registered transition swept over its progress d = 0..1 with a pinned clock: how its change is distributed.
# Made by: python Tools/transition_profile.py [Name ...]   (PresetEditor --transprofile --scene Blit.frag drone, the two
#   photos named there; a cross-fade must read 55.30 or nothing is written; rows are merged by name)
# tv total variation (a cross-fade: 55); core80 the shortest share of the sweep carrying 80 % of it (linear: 0.80);
# peak the largest single step as a share of tv; flick the clock-driven change per frame (scene A a still photo);
# flash the brightest luma above the brighter end.  Read by Tools/make_genre_configs.py (SOFT_GENRES).
